instruction: In requests/_internal_utils.py, add two module-level constants on the two lines right before "HEADER_VALIDATORS = {", with no blank line between them or after them: "_HEADER_VALIDATORS_STR = (_VALID_HEADER_NAME_RE_STR, _VALID_HEADER_VALUE_RE_STR)" and then "_HEADER_VALIDATORS_BYTE = (_VALID_HEADER_NAME_RE_BYTE, _VALID_HEADER_VALUE_RE_BYTE)". Then make the entries of HEADER_VALIDATORS refer to those names instead of spelling the tuples out: bytes: _HEADER_VALIDATORS_BYTE, and str: _HEADER_VALIDATORS_STR,.
